captureContract: A valid persisted row is required after READY.
Every operation requires a new pre-capture ticket and sequence before dispatch.
The collector writes, flushes and fsyncs the journal row before acknowledgement.
Every ordinary request requires a newer post-capture ticket and sequence after its response.
Tickets and sequence numbers establish cross-process causality; no epochs are compared.
Process creation UTC is an identity component, never an ordering clock.
Same-process deadlines, elapsed time and freshness use monotonic comparisons.
All wall deltas remain descriptive, including negative deltas.
Adverse shutdown retains the final live capture, native records through exit, and verified process/collector exit; no postmortem-zero sample is invented.
monotonicUnit: ns encoded as unsigned decimal strings
